name: Brumal-Esker

civilization.name: Meridian Concord
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: A killed landscape, vacuum-scoured and silent. The regolith holds bootprints beautifully; there are some near an ancient meteor crater that no expedition has ever claimed.
Thin air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
There is money in silicon, uranium and salvageable alloys and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
